_comment: The target manifest. Adding a drug target to this app is an edit here plus a run of
build_target.py - no application code changes. Every field that could silently be
wrong is verified by the builder rather than trusted: the clinical-to-structure
offset is re-derived from the catalogue, the crystal chain is checked residue by
residue against the AlphaFold sequence before superposing, and any catalogue entry
whose wild-type residue disagrees with the structure is dropped and counted.

targets.blurb: The canonical genomic-surveillance target. Rifampicin binds a pocket in the beta subunit of RNA polymerase, and resistance mutations cluster in the 27-codon RRDR.
targets.ligandSource: PDB 5UHC ligand RFP, superposed onto the AlphaFold model (0.79 A over 575 CA)

examples.why: The textbook rifampicin-resistance mutation. Sits 2.7 A from the drug on the closest contact residue. Start here.
Same residue, a substitution CARD has never recorded. The catalogue returns nothing; the structure still measures 2.7 A.
A drug-contact residue the catalogue has never touched at all - the clearest 'no database can help you' case.
A second catalogued hotspot, 3.0 A out. Confirms the method is not tuned to one residue.
Outside the classic RRDR window that many assays amplify, but still 2.7 A from the drug.
Catalogued as resistant yet 21 A away. The structural read is LOW and the structural read is wrong - the declared failure case.

targets.blurb: Second-line TB therapy. Moxifloxacin traps the gyrase-DNA cleavage complex, and resistance concentrates in the quinolone-resistance-determining region around residues 88-94.
targets.ligandSource: PDB 5BS8 ligand MFX, superposed onto the AlphaFold model (0.52 A over 203 CA)

examples.why: The most common fluoroquinolone-resistance mutation in TB. 2.7 A from moxifloxacin.
Same residue, not in CARD. A lookup is silent; the geometry is identical to A90V.
Position 94 is the other major hotspot, but this substitution is unrecorded.
The second classic QRDR mutation, 5.8 A out - pocket-lining rather than direct contact.
The near edge of the QRDR at 4.6 A.
Catalogued but 13.5 A from the drug. Expect a low structural score - the same honest failure as rpoB E592D.

targets.blurb: Isoniazid is a prodrug: katG activates it, and the activated form couples to NAD and inhibits InhA. The ligand modelled here is that isonicotinic-acyl-NAD adduct, which is what actually occupies the site.
targets.ligandSource: PDB 1ZID ligand ZID, superposed onto the AlphaFold model (1.59 A over 268 CA)

examples.why: The canonical inhA isoniazid-resistance mutation, 2.9 A from the activated drug.
Same residue, unrecorded substitution - the beyond-the-catalogue case on a third target.
A contact residue at 3.2 A with a large hydrophobic substitution the catalogue has not seen.
Catalogued and close in, but a conservative swap - a good test of whether the model reasons or just reads the distance.
2.6 A from the ligand at the far end of the sequence from the other hotspots.
Catalogued but 21.6 A away. The structure cannot see this mechanism, and says so.
